# Approval Note Template

## Subject

State the requested decision and equipment scope.

## Summary

Give a concise overview based only on supplied findings and retrieved evidence.

## Findings

List observed findings with application-controlled source references.

## Recommendation

Describe the proposed next action without claiming that approval or execution already occurred.

## Evidence references

List only source IDs supplied by the application.

## Uncertainty and missing information

State any unavailable measurement, unreadable value, conflict, or unsupported conclusion.
